title: Preserve prompt text while retaining the readline workaround

note.title: Preserve prompt text while retaining the readline workaround
answers: Why does an empty prompt_suffix still print a trailing space?
How should prompt and confirm render custom suffixes?
Why does the last prompt character go to stdout with err=True?
note.body:
Symptom: A prompt or confirmation with prompt_suffix="" displays an unwanted trailing space.
Root cause: src/click/termui.py:prompt (nested prompt_func) and src/click/termui.py:confirm stripped trailing spaces and passed a synthetic space to the input function.
Fix pattern: Echo the prompt's text[:-1] with nl=False, then pass text[-1:] to the input function. Preserve the exact text while retaining the readline backspace workaround and separate echo for Windows coloring.
Constraints: Keep this behavior consistent in prompt and confirm, including intentional trailing spaces. With err=True, the echoed prefix goes to stderr, but the final character goes to stdout; the entire prompt is not guaranteed to appear on stderr.
note.applies: Prompt and confirmation rendering in src/click/termui.py, especially empty suffixes, trailing whitespace, and stderr routing.
